title: chore(docs): switch to jekyll 3, digest all assets
body:
It was a bit of a nightmare: I only wanted to digest all assets and thought it would be easy.

Turns ou I had to move to jekyll 3, then handle a lot of weird sh## (expected).

In the end, everything is working but I was unable to make the dev docs task mount the website on the virtual /instantsearch.js/ path.

I guess it was working before, but it's no more. Submitted some issues to relevant (I hope) projects.

In the meantime, this should be merged
- digest all assets to avoid caching issues
- concatenate scripts that can be contenated
- minify css and js

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @redox, @Shipow and @bobylito to be potential reviewers

Yep basically its no more feasible to serve the dev app in a virtual directory /instantsearch.js/.

Building works well and generates the correct uris and assets.

But dev fails with a not root baseurl.

I think I have another solution to still serve it on the virtual directory, will add it this morning.
